verdict.rationale: Gram supports building MCP servers with external OAuth 2.0 providers (Auth0, Okta, Keycloak, custom) and mentions upstream credentials being applied when governing third-party MCP servers, implying some credential handling by the platform. However, there is no explicit evidence the platform itself runs/manages the OAuth flow end-to-end, encrypts/vaults the resulting tokens, or performs automatic token refresh — these specifics are never described. missing for 10: explicit description of platform-run OAuth flow execution, explicit encrypted credential vaulting, explicit automatic token refresh mechanism.
